assertions.name: per_nucleon_coordination_matches_A3_multiplicity
assertions.source: z=A-1=2 matches M_need(³H)=2.003 and M_need(³He)=2.061 to <3% with no fit; ⁴He carries an additional a_D^(4)≈2.53 magic factor (z·a_D^A err +0.6%).

description: Crossing/coordination structure of the building-block link 𝓑_K tested as the open body-order multiplicity M_n(A) of the θ_λ weight. The per-nucleon coordination number z=A-1 supplies M for the non-magic A=3 pair (M_need ≈ 2.00/2.06 vs z=2, no fit); doubly-magic ⁴He needs an extra super-exp a_D^(4)≈2.53 factor (z·a_D^A closes it to a few %). z·a_D^A closes ⁴He but overshoots A=3 by ~30%, so a_D is a magic-shell enhancement, not universal. Crossing number c(𝓑_K) is the Vol=0 deuteron survivor, not the A≥3 multiplier. Scope-limited (a): tested alone, not a structural exclusion.
